items.title: BABA INVESTOR ALERT: Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 5, 2026 Deadline – RGRD Law
items.summary: Robbins Geller announces a class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited for alleged securities violations. The lawsuit claims Alibaba made false statements about its control by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and engaged in unauthorized AI model distillation attacks. The stock declined following disclosure of Alibaba's inclusion on the U.S. Department of Defense's Chinese military companies list and Anthropic's accusations of illicit AI model access. Investors with substantial losses can seek appointment as lead plaintiff before October 5, 2026.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Alibaba Group Holding Limited alleging securities fraud violations. The lawsuit claims that Alibaba made materially false and misleading statements regarding its business operations and prospects, specifically related to alleged control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and ongoing distillation attacks against third-party AI models. The class period covers purchases between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

items.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – BABA
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited on behalf of investors who purchased securities between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Alibaba made false and misleading statements regarding its control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), its classification as a Chinese military company under the NDAA, and undisclosed risks of distillation attacks against third-party AI models. Investors who wish to serve as lead plaintiff must file by October 5, 2026.

items.title: Alibaba Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
items.summary: The Rosen Law Firm announced an investigation into potential securities claims against Alibaba Group Holding Limited following allegations that the company issued materially misleading business information. The investigation was triggered by a Financial Times article reporting that Anthropic accused Alibaba of obtaining illicit access to Claude AI through fake accounts. Alibaba's American Depositary Shares fell 2.7% on June 24, 2026, following the news. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.
